key_insight: LongMemEval-V2 provides a targeted benchmark that directly tests whether agent memory systems internalize environment-specific experience (affordances, workflows, failure modes) over long horizons rather than merely measuring short traces or downstream task success.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap in existing agent-memory evaluation by moving beyond user-history or short-trace metrics to directly assess long-term, environment-specific memory retention and transfer in specialized web/interactive settings.
method: Design a suite of environment-specific scenarios that require remembering interface affordances, state dynamics, recurring workflows, and failure modes across long time gaps.

Introduce probing tasks and metrics that separate memory internalization (recalling past experience) from immediate task execution, including controlled replay, ablations, and retention-over-time measurements.

Simulate "experienced colleagues" interactions to evaluate whether agents can leverage prior experience to anticipate workflows and avoid known failure modes, producing per-capability scores for long-term memory.
impact: LME-V2 gives practitioners a diagnostic tool to develop and benchmark memory mechanisms that truly capture long-term, environment-specific experience—improving robust performance in real-world interactive agents and automation systems.
visual_elements: Timeline diagram showing an agent encountering events, storing memories, and later recalling them to complete tasks (before/after comparison).
Benchmark schematic: multiple web-interface scenarios feeding into probes, metrics dashboard, and ablation blocks.
Bar/line charts comparing retention scores across models and memory ablations over increasing time gaps.
Icon set: memory store (database), agent/colleague silhouette, failure-mode warning symbol, and interface affordance checklist.
paper_title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
paper_authors: Di Wu, Zixiang Ji, Asmi Kawatkar, Bryan Kwan, Jia-Chen Gu
